children: Lenovo is marking Labor Day with two weeks of savings designed to help customers upgrade the technology they rely on every day. From August 31 through September 13, shoppers can find special offers across laptops, gaming PCs, tablets, monitors and accessories at Lenovo.com, along with additional savings opportunities throughout the sale.

Whether refreshing a home office, settling into a new school year or upgrading a gaming setup, customers can choose from promotions across Lenovo's Yoga, IdeaPad and Legion lineups, as well as business-ready ThinkPad and ThinkBook devices. Among the featured offers is the new ThinkBook 14x G1, combining a lightweight design, long battery life and 16GB of RAM, starting at $699.
Exclusive Rewards for My Lenovo Rewards Members
My Lenovo Rewards members can unlock additional value throughout the Labor Day Sale:
August 31–September 6: Earn 2X Rewards, or 6% back, on select Intel-powered gaming PCs.
September 7 only: Earn 2X Rewards sitewide, or 6% back on purchases, for one day only.
Free expedited shipping on qualifying orders.
Not a member? My Lenovo Rewards is free to join, with rewards that can be redeemed on future purchases.
More Ways to Save Throughout the Sale
Gamers can save an additional 5% on select gaming PCs from September 4–6.
Beginning September 7, customers can save more as they spend more with a threshold offer of up to $100 off purchases over $500, available through September 13.

“Labor Day comes at a natural time to take stock of whether the technology you rely on is still keeping up with the way you work, learn and spend your downtime,” said Carlo Savino, Vice President of Global eCommerce at Lenovo. “For us, value is about more than a price. It’s about helping customers find technology that fits their needs today and continues to deliver long after the purchase. With choices spanning productivity, creativity and gaming, our Labor Day Sale makes it easier to find the right device while taking advantage of meaningful savings and member benefits.”
Featured Labor Day Offers
Select offers available throughout the August 31–September 13 campaign include:
ThinkBook 14x G1 – Starting at $699
Monitors – Starting at $69.99
Tablets – Starting at $99.99
Week 1: August 31–September 6
ThinkPad T Series – Starting at $1,599
Accessories – Starting at $8.99
JLab Go Air Pop True Wireless Earbuds – 20% off, $19.99
Jabra Evolve2 65 MS Stereo – 52% off
Week 2: September 7–13
ThinkPad T Series – Starting at $1,779
ThinkPad X13 – Starting at $1,409
Accessories – Starting at $8.99
Visit Lenovo.com/deals to explore full sale details, limited-time offers and exclusive member benefits.
Offers valid while supplies last. Exclusions may apply. Shop early for best availability.
About Lenovo

Lenovo is a US$83 billion revenue global technology powerhouse, ranked #196 in the Fortune Global 500, and serving millions of customers every day in 180 markets. Guided by its vision of “Smarter Technology for All”, Lenovo is executing a Hybrid AI strategy that spans Personal AI – one personal AI, multiple devices; and Enterprise AI – helping customers turn data into insights and value. This strategy is delivered through the Group’s commitment to world-class innovation and a full-stack AI portfolio, including devices (PCs, workstations, smartphones, tablets, accessories), infrastructure solutions (server, storage, edge, high performance computing and software defined infrastructure), as well as software, solutions, and services. With a global footprint spanning more than 20 research and development locations and a global supply chain that includes more than 30 manufacturing sites across 10 markets, Lenovo is widely recognized for its operational excellence.
